_doc: Plan 11A quotas, checked by scripts/seed/check-personas.js (code only). Language and style are measured on each persona's 15 E replies. A persona counts for a language when that language's share of its tokens is >= languageShareMin.

codeSwitchPersonas.label: personas whose replies switch language mid-sentence (>= 3 of 15 replies)

terse.rule: avg words <= 6 and < 30% of replies end with . ! ?

formal.rule: >= 80% of replies start with a capital and >= 70% end with . ! ?, < 0.2 emoji per reply

cities._visible: a seed is visible when it passes the gate both ways against a typical new user (the most common B answer per attribute, no dealbreakers); fake personas don't count

pairs: every pair in seed/pairs.json must be in one city and pass the gate, except expected 'gated' pairs, which must fail it
